b.x: Three liters per person per day cover drinking and minimal hygiene. In heat, illness, or pregnancy, go up. Two weeks for a household of four is about 170 L — a tank, jugs, and a refill plan, not 80 loose bottles on the floor.
Use this guide’s calculator for your number. Then pick the container: 20 L packs and stacks; 2 L moves through daily life.
01 Pre-filter what you can see: settle, a clean cloth, or a coffee filter. That does not make the water finished. It only takes the solid, for the boil or for the real filter.
02 Boil: one minute at a visible rolling boil (three at altitude). It is the safest method if you have fire and a vessel.
03 Chlorine or silver tablets according to the label — not by eye.

04 Bleach only if unscented, soap-free, with the strength on the label. On a ~2.0–2.5% bottle: 4 drops per litre of already-clear water (8 if still cloudy). On 5–9%: 2 drops (4 if cloudy). Mix, wait 30 minutes, it must smell faintly of chlorine. No strength on the label, boil. The full protocol is in Purification.
Flood, mud, and sewage are not solved with a few drops. Do not drink them. Well or river water near a city wants filter + boil. When unsure, do not invent chemistry.
Opaque container or in the dark, cool, away from cleaning products.
Rotate every six to twelve months. Drink the old, replace.
A covered, clean rooftop tank is worth more than any gadget. Know the valve.
